transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I guess I’ve been feeling like I’m always up and moving. Even on a quiet day, I’ll go from the garden club list to my knitting bag to travel papers, and I haven’t really finished one before I’m on to the next.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep lately, or that you feel rested even if you don’t sleep much?
No… I don’t think so. I still seem to need my usual sleep, and if I don’t get it, I feel it.
Do you find yourself talking more than usual or feeling like you need to keep talking without a pause?
I’m not sure… I don’t think I talk more than usual. I can be chatty sometimes, but I haven’t noticed needing to keep talking nonstop or anything like that.
Have you been feeling unusually happy, excited, or irritable lately, even if things aren’t particularly going well?
Not especially, no. I mean… I have my moods like anyone, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been unusually happy or excited. Irritable… maybe a little now and then, but nothing that stands out to me.
Have you noticed yourself starting more projects or feeling the need to keep moving or doing things, even if it’s not necessary?

A little, I suppose. I do tend to keep getting up and shifting from one thing to another… like the garden club list, then my knitting, then some travel papers. I don’t always finish one before I’m onto the next.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t think so… not for two weeks like that. I’ve had low days, of course, but I wouldn’t say most of the day nearly every day.
Have you noticed that your mood has been persistently elevated, unusually upbeat, or irritable most of the time lately, even when things aren’t particularly going well?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed being upbeat or irritable most of the time. Nothing like that, really.
Have you found yourself speaking so quickly that others have trouble keeping up, or have they mentioned that you seem to be talking more than usual without pausing?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I talk, but I don’t think anyone’s said they can’t keep up with me or anything like that.
Have you noticed that your mood has been unusually high, expansive, or irritable most of the time lately, even when things aren't particularly going well?
No… I haven’t really noticed anything like that. My mood’s been about the same, I think.
Have you, for most of the day, nearly every day lately, felt unusually high, expansive, or irritable in mood, even when things aren’t particularly going well?
No… not most of the day or anything. I haven’t really felt unusually high or that kind of irritable lately.
Have you noticed a significant decrease in the amount of sleep you need lately, where you feel rested even after only a few hours of sleep?
No, I don’t think so. My sleep hasn’t changed like that… I wouldn’t say I feel rested on just a few hours.
Have you noticed that your thoughts have been racing lately, or that you jump from one idea to another quickly, more than usual for you?
Not really… I don’t think my thoughts have been racing more than usual. I mean, my mind wanders some, but nothing new lately.

Have you had a period recently where you've been much more active than usual in work, social, or personal projects — like starting a lot of new things or pushing yourself to keep going beyond what's normal for you?

Maybe a little, but not like some big burst. I just… I’m often up and moving around, going from one thing to another. Like I’ll start with the garden club list, then end up in my knitting bag, then looking at travel papers before I’ve really finished the first thing.
Have you had a period lasting at least four days where you felt unusually energetic or had a mood that was noticeably more upbeat or irritable, along with doing more activities than usual?
No… I can’t say I’ve had a stretch like that. I have days where I’m busier, but not four days of feeling unusually energetic or anything like that.

Have you had any distinct period — even if it was just for a few days — where your mood was clearly more elevated, expansive, or irritable than usual, along with feeling much more energetic or driven to do things?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed any clear few days like that, where I felt unusually up or driven. Just my usual kind of busy, I guess.

Have you had any time, even if just for a day or two, where your mood was clearly different—like being unusually upbeat, irritable, or high—along with feeling much more energetic or driven to do things more than usual?
No, not really. I mean, I have normal ups and downs, but I haven’t noticed anything like being unusually high or driven, even for a day or two.

Have you had any time — even if just for a day or two — when you felt clearly different from your usual self, like you had an unusually high mood, lots of energy, or a strong push to get things done, even if that’s not typical for you?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had days where I felt a little better or got more done, but not like a clearly different version of myself or anything.

Have you ever had even a single day when your mood was clearly different from usual—like being unusually upbeat, irritable, or energized—along with a strong push to get things done or feeling like you didn’t need as much rest?
No… I can’t really think of a day like that. Maybe I’ve had better days, but not where I felt unusually energized or like I didn’t need rest.
Have you felt noticeably more restless or unable to sit still lately, like you need to keep moving even when you're not trying to accomplish something?
A little, yes. If I sit too long, I get sort of stirred up inside… like I should get up and straighten something or go check on something.

Have you had any time, even just for a few hours, when you felt distinctly different from your usual self—like unusually upbeat, energized, or driven to get things done, even if that’s not typical for you?
No, I don’t think so. I get ordinary better moments, I guess, but nothing that feels distinctly different like that.
